db:select.doc:name: Select all workspaces (to filter out any collection whose workspace is locked)
Select all collections
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, name, parent_id, workspace_id, variables_json FROM syskm.collections ORDER BY name

db:select.doc:name: Select all requests (full — RequestPanel builds its draft straight from this tree, never a separate GET /requests/{id}, so a narrower projection here silently drops preRequest/postResponse/inputDataSets/description on every edit-save cycle)
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, collection_id, name, description, pre_request_json, request_json, post_response_json, input_data_sets_json FROM syskm.requests ORDER BY name

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::rowToRequest var lockedWorkspaceIds = (vars.allWorkspaces default []) filter ((w) -> w.password_hash != null) map ((w) -> w.id) var cols = (vars.allCollections default []) filter ((c) -> !(lockedWorkspaceIds contains c.workspace_id)) var reqs = (vars.allRequests default []) map (r) -> rowToRequest(r) fun childrenOf(pid) = cols filter ((c) -> (if (pid == null) (c.parent_id == null) else (c.parent_id == pid))) fun node(c) = { id: c.id, name: c.name, workspaceId: c.workspace_id, variables: read(c.variables_json default "{}", "application/json"), requests: reqs filter ((r) -> r.collectionId == c.id), folders: childrenOf(c.id) map ((child) -> node(child)) } --- childrenOf(null) map ((c) -> node(c))

db:insert.doc:name: Insert collection
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO syskm.collections (id, name, parent_id, workspace_id, variables_json) VALUES (:id, :name, :parentId, :workspaceId, :variables)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ id: payload.id, name: payload.name, parentId: payload.parentId, workspaceId: payload.workspaceId, variables: write(payload.variables, "application/json") }]

db:update.doc:name: Update collection name
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE syskm.collections SET name = :name WHERE id = :id

db:update.doc:name: Update collection variables
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE syskm.collections SET variables_json = :variables WHERE id = :id

db:update.doc:name: Reparent collection
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE syskm.collections SET parent_id = :parentId WHERE id = :id

db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ id: payload.id, collectionId: payload.collectionId, name: payload.name, description: payload.description, preRequest: write(payload.preRequest, "application/json"), request: write(payload.request, "application/json"), postResponse: write(payload.postResponse, "application/json"), inputDataSets: write(payload.inputDataSets, "application/json") }]
